Name: CommandControlLocationLotShowing
Content:
declare @$tracked bit, @$location bit, @$lot bit

if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_instock_split' and val = '1') begin
  if @@id <> '' and object_id('dmctvtrlo') is not null begin
    exec sp_executesql N'select @location = vi_tri_yn, @lot = lo_yn from dmctvtrlo where ma_ct = '@@id'', N'@location bit output, @lot bit output', @location = @$location output, @lot = @$lot output
  end
  select @$tracked = 1
  if @$location is null select @$location = cast(rtrim(val) as bit) from options where name = 'm_kt_td_vitri_yn'
  if @$lot is null select @$lot = cast(rtrim(val) as bit) from options where name = 'm_kt_td_lo_yn'
end else select @$location = 1, @$lot = 1, @$tracked = 0

select @message = @message + 'this._tracked = ' + rtrim(@$tracked) + ';this._tracked$Location = ' + rtrim(@$location) + ';this._tracked$Lot = ' + rtrim(@$lot) + ';'

if @$location = 0 select @message = @message + 'this._fields[this._getColumnOrder(''ma_vi_tri'') - 1].Visible = false;'
if @$lot = 0 select @message = @message + 'this._fields[this._getColumnOrder(''ma_lo'') - 1].Visible = false;'

CreateTicket
Content:
declare @ticket varchar(32), @filename varchar(128), @description nvarchar(128), @compactMode char(1)
select @ticket = lower(replace(newid(),'-',''))
if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_compact_mode' and rtrim(val) = '1') select @compactMode = '1' else select @compactMode = '0'
if @@language = 'v' select @filename = case when @compactMode = '0' then 'SIDetail.xlsx' else 'SIDetail3.xlsx' end, @description = N'Phiếu xuất bán'
else select @filename = case when @compactMode = '0' then 'SIDetail2.xlsx' else 'SIDetail4.xlsx' end, @description = N'Phiếu xuất bán'

if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_instock_split' and val = '1') begin
  declare @$location bit, @$lot bit
  if 'DX1' <> '' and object_id('dmctvtrlo') is not null begin
    exec sp_executesql N'select @location = vi_tri_yn, @lot = lo_yn from dmctvtrlo where ma_ct = ''DX1''', N'@location bit output, @lot bit output', @location = @$location output, @lot = @$lot output
  end
  if @$location is null select @$location = cast(rtrim(val) as bit) from options where name = 'm_kt_td_vitri_yn'
  if @$lot is null select @$lot = cast(rtrim(val) as bit) from options where name = 'm_kt_td_lo_yn'

  select @filename = case
    when @$location = 0 and @$Lot = 0 then case when @@language = 'v' then 'SIDetail3.xlsx' else 'SIDetail4.xlsx' end
    when @$location = 1 and @$Lot = 0 then case when @@language = 'v' then 'SIDetail5.xlsx' else 'SIDetail6.xlsx' end
    when @$location = 0 and @$Lot = 1 then case when @@language = 'v' then 'SIDetail7.xlsx' else 'SIDetail8.xlsx' end
    when @$location = 1 and @$Lot = 1 then case when @@language = 'v' then 'SIDetail.xlsx' else 'SIDetail2.xlsx' end
  end
end
insert into @@sysDatabaseName..ticket values(@ticket, @@userID, 'SITran', @filename, @description, '@@appDatabaseName', getdate());
